about.title: About Pelagic Pools
text: From recurring weekly service to high-intent problem solving like leak detection and equipment repair, Pelagic Pools is the go-to full-service pool company for the area.
Losing water? We pinpoint shell, plumbing, and equipment leaks with non-destructive diagnostics — then fix them right.
We want the best for you and your pool — so we recommend a maintenance schedule catered to your specific needs. Quality pool care with purpose, without hassle.
